Seasonal Vehicle Protection Special

Sample offer: save 15% when combining an eligible exterior detailing service with ceramic coating or paint protection service.

This sample promotion offers 15% savings when an eligible exterior detailing service is combined with ceramic coating or a paint protection service. It is designed for drivers who want to clean and prepare the exterior before adding protection for the season ahead.

Regular exposure to road film, wet weather, sunlight, insects, and daily parking can leave contamination on paint and glass. Seasonal service provides an opportunity to inspect the finish, address appropriate buildup, and select protection that matches how the vehicle is used.

Eligible service concept

The offer applies when a qualifying exterior detail is booked together with an eligible ceramic coating or paint protection service. Suitable combinations may include exterior cleaning and decontamination followed by ceramic coating, or preparation work paired with selected paint protection film coverage.

Eligibility depends on the vehicle’s condition and the services chosen. Paint correction, water-spot removal, film coverage, and other preparation are quoted according to the work required. The promotion does not imply that every vehicle needs the same combination.

What customers can expect

Tell us about the vehicle, how it is used, and the areas you want to improve.

Bring the vehicle for an inspection so the exterior condition can be reviewed.

Receive a clear recommendation for eligible preparation and protection options.

Confirm the scope, expected result, care guidance, and final price before work begins.

Schedule the appointment based on service time and workshop availability.

The team will explain what the selected protection can and cannot do. Ceramic coating can support gloss, water behavior, and easier cleaning, while paint protection film adds a physical layer over chosen areas. Neither option removes the need for safe washing and ongoing maintenance.

Preparing for the appointment

Share any recent paintwork, existing coatings or film, known chips, scratches, or areas of concern when requesting the offer. This information helps the team plan the inspection. Remove valuables and personal items that could limit access around the vehicle.

After the service, follow the specific cure and care instructions provided for the products installed. Washing or exposure guidance can vary, so use the instructions supplied with the completed work rather than a generic timeline.

How to request the offer

Contact HyperAuto Care and mention the Seasonal Vehicle Protection Special when requesting an appointment. Provide the vehicle year, make, model, approximate condition, and the type of protection you are considering. Photos may help with an initial discussion, but final pricing follows an in-person inspection where needed.

Sample promotion terms

Appointment is required and scheduling is subject to availability.

The 15% saving applies to eligible service combinations only.

The offer cannot be combined with another discount or promotion.

Final pricing depends on vehicle size, condition, preparation, and selected coverage.

Additional correction or repair is quoted separately when required.

The promotion is available for a limited time and may be updated or withdrawn.

This is sample promotional content for the HyperAuto Care template and can be replaced with a current shop offer. To discuss an eligible combination, review the available Services and contact the team with the condition and goals for your vehicle.
